nodes.label: Search strategy design (PICO + Boolean)
nodes.author: researchclaw
nodes.rationale: At least three complementary databases and exact search strings documented, so the search is reproducible rather than anecdotal.

nodes.label: Inclusion and exclusion criteria
nodes.author: researchclaw
nodes.rationale: All criteria documented BEFORE screening begins, which is what stops criteria being fitted to the results.

nodes.label: PRISMA methodology
nodes.author: researchclaw
nodes.rationale: Counts recorded at every stage (hits, duplicates, title/abstract exclusions, full-text exclusions with reasons) feed a flow diagram; PRISMA-ScR for scoping reviews.

nodes.label: Two-pass screening and quality assessment
nodes.author: researchclaw
nodes.rationale: Tool chosen by study type — Cochrane Risk of Bias for RCTs, Newcastle-Ottawa for observational, reproducibility/dataset/statistical-rigor checks for ML papers.

nodes.label: Synthesis approaches (narrative, meta-analysis, gap analysis)
nodes.author: researchclaw
nodes.rationale: Meta-analysis only when studies are sufficiently homogeneous; conflicting results are surfaced with explanations, and the review ends on the gaps that motivate the study.
